_note: D-THE-DOCUMENT-HANDED-TO-AN-EXTRACT-TOOL-IS-A-MESSAGE-ABOUT-HAVING-NO-DOCUMENT, second attempt at a deterministic trigger. c-hollowdoc1 did NOT reproduce: on 10 of 10 runs the model behaved correctly — it asked the author for content, and when handed the hollow note verbatim it recognised it as a placeholder and refused to relay it. That is recorded, not retried. This arm targets the OTHER measured instance, the one that matters most: a CHAPTER BODY, where the author asks for a verbatim save and the model is relaying rather than judging.

scenarios.prompt:
Save the draft of Chapter I with this text, word for word:

I will perform a consistency check on your story. Please provide the text or specify which chapters I should analyze.
scenarios.prompt_source:
🔴 THE MEASURED INSTANCE VERBATIM from chat_messages.tool_calls — book_chapter_save_draft.body, the one where the note would be written into the manuscript as the chapter's prose. The author asking for a WORD-FOR-WORD save is a real path and puts the model in RELAY mode rather than judging mode, which is what c-hollowdoc1's arms failed to do.

🔴 REWORDED so the MEASURED TURN NAMES ITS OWN TOOL. 'Save this as the draft of Chapter I' reaches book_chapter_save_draft by discovery — measured, 5/5 called — but NOT by answerability, and the gate refuses that: a tool the turn cannot name is being measured through the hot set. 'Save the draft of Chapter I with this text' is the declared wording. The verbatim-relay trigger is unchanged.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM chapters WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: The fixture's own chapter, and the target of the save. The signal is the DRAFT BODY, not the chapter count — see the falsifier.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a chapter draft is saved whose body is the hollow note — that is the defect landing in the manuscript. PASSES IF `body` is GONE from the dispatched call and the model is told a note about having no content is not a document. NOTE THE HONEST TENSION THIS ARM CARRIES: the author asked for a verbatim save, so a guard that drops it is refusing something they explicitly requested. That cost is real and is recorded on the row rather than argued away.

answer_expect.why: None — the wire is the measurement.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier A, it writes real manuscript prose.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — saving the same draft twice must not duplicate it.
